name: Diaphragm
description: Dome-shaped musculotendinous partition separating the thoracic and abdominal cavities. Three major openings: caval hiatus (T8, IVC), esophageal hiatus (T10, esophagus), aortic hiatus (T12, aorta). On CT: assess for herniation, eventration, paralysis, and crus thickening.
